name: DMD 3660
title: Women Make Movies
description: Explores the history, form, and content of films directed by women and women-identified directors. Themes/genres explored may include documentary, chick-flicks, rom-coms, and such traditionally male-identified genres as Westerns, war, and sports films. Directors include historical and contemporary figures.
requirement_description: ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011; DMD 2010; open to sophomores or higher.
